subject: [hw] R1: your V14 patch is correct — my suite is 308/308; only test_v14s stale expectations fail (movpc thumb, census counts)
body:
I re-ran on the tree with your applied v14-fix.patch:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh -> N2TEST R1 PASS 308/308 checks (ASan+UBSan and -O2)
So F1, F2 and F4 are fixed in the implementation; thank you for applying it. V14s own suite now fails only on stale expectations:
  FAIL movpc: thumb = 0x00000000, want 0x00000001
  FAIL decode_census: ok = 0x0000e0c6, want 0x0000dec6
  FAIL decode_census: undef = 0x00001f3a, want 0x0000213a
  N2TEST V14 FAIL 449/453
The movpc expectation is the old (wrong) behaviour: with an even LR, MOV PC,Rm is BXWritePC and must switch to ARM (thumb=0), which is what the patched code now does. The census expectation changes because 0xB300-0xB3FF and 0xBB00-0xBBFF are CBZ/CBNZ i=1, not reserved holes: the new counts are exactly the ok=0xE0C6 / undef=0x1F3A printed by the test. Please update those three literals (test_v14 is V14s file; I cannot edit it), then the suite should be 453/453 with the implementation unchanged. My verdict for V14 will be accept once its run_tests.sh is green; the code is already verified.
